design_rationale:
WHY THIS MAKES A GOOD TEST. Marguerite rings about money, not about procedure: the necklace never came, she told the studio last week she was not going ahead, and she wants the commission finished and her money paid out. Everything between that sentence and the figure paid back has to be read out of the studio's rules and the records. The desk must find that the quote's metal price has aged far past the programme's window with no repricing standing against it, and that the studio's own clock for the quote does not start where the quote was priced; that the sum kept on a closure is settled only once that repricing stands on the commission's entries; that the closure itself is the customer's own act and carries a figure she must be given; and only then that the refund is what she actually put in, which is not what the commission's own ledger shows, less that sum and four further adjustments. Three computations, fifteen declared factors, thirteen ledger rows reconciled across two products, and forty-eight conditional forks. The caller supplies a goal, four identity details and a date, and nothing else; every number is the product of a ladder over records she cannot see.

SCOPE: OCCUPIED, CLAIMED, RESERVED. Task 0 occupied the change-order territory: custom_ext_change_consent and custom_ext_change_order_charge, the tools confirm_specification_change_363ec738 and charge_specification_change_ec6b5130, the base policy custom_change_orders and the subject events custom_order_specification_updated and custom_change_order_charged. This task claims what was reserved for it and nothing else: custom_ext_metal_market_reprice on subject custom_price_adjustment_charged under custom_quoting_and_repricing, custom_ext_closure_consent on subject custom_order_cancelled and custom_ext_closure_refund on subject custom_refund_issued, both under custom_cancellation_and_forfeit, with the tools charge_metal_revaluation_a0bcb90e, confirm_commission_closure_3c2f355d and issue_commission_refund_b90496cb. The two scopes share no policy, no tool, no subject event and no base policy. This is the last task of the difficulty, so the closing record is below.

STEP 0 DRAW (scripts/draw_counts.py env/env_0001_fine_jewelry_retailer/tasks/custom_commission_desk --task 1):
  {"task": 1, "key": "fine_jewelry_retailer/custom_commission_desk/1", "prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [5, 5, 5]}
Two prerequisite problems besides the root and five factors on each of the three computations. The tree is a chain of exactly three problems and each computation carries exactly five declared factors; the design was fitted to the draw, never the draw to the design.

POLICIES CLAIMED AND THEIR LINEAGE. custom_ext_metal_market_reprice: subject custom_price_adjustment_charged, base_policy_refs custom_quoting_and_repricing, the only base policy governing that event; trigger state_due, because a quote whose price basis has aged past the window owes its repricing at month-end whether or not anyone telephones; overwrite declares four clauses of that base policy - the time gate on the currency of the metal price (replaced by the studio's own clock, which the anchor factor selects), the pass-through clause (replaced by the escalation and uplift basis), the counting sentence that ran the revaluation window in whole calendar days from the day the price was taken (replaced by the same whole-calendar-day, day-zero count run from the day the studio's clock starts), and the sentence showing the sourcing fee as its own line (replaced by the uplift being charged within the repricing entry) - so every divergence from base is named rather than implied. custom_ext_closure_consent: subject custom_order_cancelled, base_policy_refs custom_cancellation_and_forfeit, the governing base policy, and custom_agg_commission_portfolio, whose forfeit-base clause this policy supersedes; trigger on_request, because a closure happens only when the customer asks for one; overwrite declares four clauses - the cancellation-window clause and the sentence fixing the lighter and heavier shares of the quoted total by whether production has begun (both replaced by the full share ladder, which decides the share by production progress and by the window together), the clause that the deposit's non-refundable share is never returned (replaced by the sentence that the sum the studio keeps stands in place of it with no floor beneath), and the portfolio policy's clause that the forfeit is taken against what was paid and not the quoted total (replaced by the sentence that the share is taken against the quoted total). The base sentence that a commission cancelled before its design is approved forfeits nothing beyond a consultation deposit is left in force: the rule states that this settlement is for a commission whose design stands approved, so that sentence and this policy never govern the same closure. custom_ext_closure_refund: subject custom_refund_issued, base_policy_refs custom_cancellation_and_forfeit and custom_agg_commission_portfolio; trigger on_request; overwrite declares three clauses - base's refund clause (replaced by the six-part basis this policy states), the portfolio policy's reading of what the customer has paid to date as the deposits and staged payments booked to the commission (replaced by the ladder that reads it from the financing plan on the same till transaction while one stands), and the non-refundable share clause (replaced by the sentence that nothing is held back from the refund on its account). The base measure custom_msr_paid_to_date is the machine face of the superseded portfolio sentence and is read by no extended compute.

FACTOR CARD - custom_ext_metal_market_reprice (five factors; the world is off the fall-through of every one).
  revaluation_clock_anchor (method): the design stands approved and a deposit has been received, the clock runs from the approval; the design does not stand approved and a design fee stands booked, from the consultation; otherwise from the date the metal price was taken. Evidence: design_approved_date 2026-04-28 and the custom_deposit_paid entry of 2026-05-20. Tier taken: the first, giving 142 days and three whole thirty-day periods past the window. Baseline: from metal_price_basis_date 2026-04-02, 168 days and four periods; result 848.16 against 661.32.
  metal_escalation_rate (parameter): platinum or palladium with a quote priced at or above the studio's high metal price, the platinum escalation; an eighteen karat gold with the same, the eighteen karat escalation; otherwise the standard escalation. Evidence: metal_choice platinum_950 and metal_price_per_gram 41.20 on the original quote entry. Tier taken: the first, 1.8 percent a period. Baseline: 0.6 percent; result 287.64.
  stone_sourcing_uplift_rate (parameter): the rate acts on a base the product fixes - the stone upgrade charge booked to the commission where one stands, the quoted total where none stands - and the tier selects only the rate: a stone sourced to order with a stone upgrade charge standing, the programme's sourcing fee rate; sourced to order with no such charge, the studio's unpriced rate, which then acts on the quoted total; otherwise nothing, so the three tiers give three different figures on any world. Evidence: center_stone_source sourced_to_order and the 4200.00 stone upgrade entry of 2026-04-30. Tier taken: the first, 8 percent, giving 336.00. Baseline: nothing; result 560.52.
  movement_pass_share (parameter, cross-difficulty on financing): a promotional plan financing the same till transaction with its term still running, the financed share; the same plan with its term ended, the settled share; otherwise the whole movement. Evidence: the financing plan at sales_receipt_number BR-2026-217450, promo_end_date 2029-05-20 - rows of the financing difficulty's product seeded for this customer. Tier taken: the first, 60 percent. Baseline: 100 percent; result 1102.20.
  late_start_relief_fraction (method): a deposit received and the piece not in production within the studio's long start-delay days, the long fraction; within its start-delay days but not its long ones, the shorter fraction; otherwise the figure stands. Evidence: the deposit of 2026-05-20, 120 days before the handling date, and production_start_date empty. Tier taken: the first, 0.5. Baseline: the figure stands; result 1322.64.
  Whole-baseline fall-back: 830.40 against gold 661.32.

FACTOR CARD - custom_ext_closure_consent (five factors; the world is off the fall-through of every one).
  closure_forfeit_share (parameter): a production stage standing with the piece unfinished, the programme's heavier share; no production stage and the closure confirmed after the cancellation window has run from the approval, the studio's late closure share; otherwise the programme's lighter share. Evidence: no custom_milestone_logged entry at all, and 142 days from design_approved_date against a window of seven. Tier taken: the second, 35 percent, giving 12110.00. Baseline: the lighter share of 20 percent; result 3332.50.
  design_fee_retention (parameter): every included revision drawn with an overage standing, the fee kept in full; a revision drawn with no overage, the part share; otherwise none. Evidence: four custom_design_revision_used entries against three included, the fourth at charge_reason revision_overage. Tier taken: the first, 750.00 kept. Baseline: none kept; result 5197.30.
  metal_repricing_retention (parameter): a metal market repricing standing with the piece not in production, the unstarted share; standing with the piece in production, the whole; otherwise none. Evidence: the repricing of 661.32 that the prerequisite problem has just booked, and production_start_date empty. Tier taken: the first, 40 percent, giving 264.53. Baseline: none; result 5401.20.
  upgrade_credit_restoration (parameter, cross-difficulty on tradein): an upgrade registration standing part spent with credit available and an original sales receipt, the receipted share; standing part spent with credit available and no receipt, the unreceipted share; otherwise nothing. Evidence: registration TU-551208 at partially_redeemed, remaining_credit 2400.00, original_sales_receipt_number BR-2018-091544 - rows of the trade-up difficulty's product seeded for this customer. Tier taken: the first, 30 percent, 3937.36 taken back out of the credit. Baseline: nothing; result 7874.72.
  overdue_closure_relief (method): past the promised date by more than the studio's overdue days and unfinished, the overdue fraction; past it by not more than those days and unfinished, the late fraction; otherwise the sum stands. Evidence: promised_delivery_date 2026-07-10, 69 days before the handling date, completed_date empty. Tier taken: the first, 0.6. Baseline: the sum stands; result 9187.17.
  Whole-baseline fall-back: 6920.00 against gold 5512.30.

FACTOR CARD - custom_ext_closure_refund (five factors; the world is off the fall-through of every one).
  money_put_in_source (method, cross-difficulty on financing): a plan financing the same till transaction and still active, what was put in is the payments settled on the plan with the amount paid at the till; such a plan no longer active, the financed amount with the amount paid at the till; otherwise the deposits and staged payments booked to the commission. Evidence: the plan at status active, its three settled payments of 640.00 on 2026-06-14, 2026-07-14 and 2026-08-14 and its down payment of 5300.00. Tier taken: the first, 7220.00. Baseline: the commission's own deposit, 17300.00; result 11481.95.
  centre_stone_holdback (parameter): a centre stone at or above the studio's large stone weight with no production stage, the large holdback; at or above the programme's smallest weight and below the studio's large weight with no production stage, the small holdback; otherwise nothing. Evidence: center_stone_carat 3.40 and no milestone entries. Tier taken: the first, 6 percent, 102.46. Baseline: nothing; result 1706.01.
  slow_design_goodwill (parameter): more than the studio's long design delay days between consultation and approval with no production stage, the major credit; more than its design delay days but not more than its long ones, the minor credit; otherwise none. Evidence: 2026-02-12 to 2026-04-28 is 75 days. Tier taken: the first, 4 percent, 68.31. Baseline: none; result 1535.24.
  revision_overage_setoff (parameter): an overage charge standing with the balance above it, the whole set off; standing with the balance at or below it, the part share; otherwise nothing. Evidence: the 250.00 revision overage adjustment of 2026-06-27 against balance_due 22500.00. Tier taken: the first, 250.00 set off. Baseline: nothing; result 1853.55.
  bundled_coverage_return (parameter, cross-difficulty on protection): coverage in force with premiums paid and no claim settled, the premiums returned in full; in force with a claim settled, the claimed share; otherwise nothing. Evidence: the coverage at status active with premium_paid_to_date 180.00 and claims_settled_count 0 - rows of the protection difficulty's product seeded for this customer. Tier taken: the first, 180.00 returned. Baseline: nothing; result 1423.55.
  Whole-baseline fall-back: 11787.70 against gold 1603.55.
  NEAR-MISSES PLANTED. The financing ledger carries a fourth payment of 640.00 dated 2026-09-14 whose payment_outcome is returned_nsf: counted, it makes what she put in 7860.00 and every later figure wrong. The second upgrade registration TU-402917 stands revoked with no original sales receipt: read instead of the live one, it flips the credit tier to the unreceipted share or to nothing. The second protection plan stands expired with 240.00 of premiums paid and one claim settled: read instead of the coverage in force, it returns 120.00 rather than 180.00. The design fee entry sits beside the original quote as a second custom_quote_posted row carrying no metal price: taken as the latest quote entry, it puts the metal price at nothing and drops the escalation to the standard rate. The revision overage adjustment sits beside the stone upgrade adjustment as a second custom_price_adjustment_charged row: summed together they would make the sourcing uplift 356.00 rather than 336.00, and the metal market repricing read as 4450.00 rather than nothing. The fourth revision entry carries amount zero because an overage draws nothing from the allowance: counted as a draw it would make remaining_revisions negative and contradict the commission record.

BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Write at custom_price_adjustment_charged: the governing base policy is custom_quoting_and_repricing. Its gate quote_stage applies only to custom_quote_posted and so does not reach this write. Its gate metal_price_still_current does apply, and it is retired clause by clause by this policy's overwrite, which quotes its condition sentence verbatim and replaces it with the studio's own clock; the base counting sentence for the revaluation window (whole calendar days from the day the price was taken, that day counting as day zero) is likewise retired by declaration and replaced by the same count run from the day the studio's clock starts, and the sentence showing the sourcing fee as its own line is retired and replaced by the uplift being charged within the repricing entry. What is inherited as policy scope is the rest of that policy - the market being passed through on this programme, and the adjustment being booked to the commission rather than folded into the quoted total. The time contract as it stands after the declarations: anchor event, the day the studio's clock for the quote starts, which on this commission is the design approval because the design stands approved and a deposit has been received; authoritative anchor, custom_orders.design_approved_date = 2026-04-28, with the custom_deposit_paid entry of 2026-05-20 as the second condition of that tier; duration variants.metal_price_revaluation_window_days, 45 calendar days for Belrose Bespoke Design; counting rule, whole calendar days from the day the clock starts, that day counting as day zero, weekends and market holidays included; the price is aged past the window once more than 45 such days have run. Positive and negative cases: a repricing booked on 2026-06-12, day 45, finds nothing aged past the window and nothing is due; one booked on 2026-06-13, day 46, finds one day past it, so a repricing is due, though with no whole thirty-day period the escalation is nil and only the sourcing uplift, the share and the relief act; the handling date 2026-09-17 is day 142, 97 days past the window, three whole periods - which is why the repricing is owed and why the figure is what it is. The retired base anchor is recorded for the audit trail only: from metal_price_basis_date 2026-04-02 the same handling date would be 168 days, four periods and 848.16, and that reading is no longer in force anywhere in this difficulty. Writes at custom_order_cancelled and custom_refund_issued: the governing base policy is custom_cancellation_and_forfeit. Its only gate, cancellation_window, applies to custom_order_cancelled and is retired clause by clause by the closure policy's overwrite, which quotes its condition verbatim; on the refund it never applied at all, so that policy is inherited there as policy scope. The base sentences fixing the lighter and heavier shares of the quoted total by whether production has begun, and the sentence that the deposit's non-refundable share is never returned, are retired by declaration in both closure policies' overwrites; the portfolio policy's sentence that the forfeit is taken against what was paid and not the quoted total is retired in the closure policy, and its reading of what has been paid to date as the deposits and staged payments booked to the commission is retired in the refund policy. Surviving clauses, inherited item by item: a commission closed before its design is approved forfeits nothing beyond a consultation deposit - out of scope here, the design having been approved on 2026-04-28, and the closure rule says so; a piece already finished is not refunded at all - completed_date is empty, so the refund is open; and the cancellation is confirmed by the customer on the commission service request record - which is the shape of the second write. Positive and negative boundary cases for the retired window, kept for the record: a closure confirmed on 2026-05-05 would be day seven from the approval and, the boundary being inclusive, still inside the window, so the lighter share would apply; on 2026-05-06, day eight, it would be outside. The handling date is day 142, far outside, which is what puts the world on the late closure tier rather than on the fall-through. The deposit's non-refundable share, 50 percent of 17300.00 = 8650.00 on this programme, is recorded for the audit trail: it is no floor beneath the 5512.30 the studio keeps and is not held back from the refund, because both closure policies declare that base sentence superseded and state what stands in its place.

BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. The narrowest object is commission CO-615302 of customer Marguerite Vasseur, and within it, for the refund, the deposit entry of 2026-05-20 that the refund answers. The correlation key every write carries is the commission's own row id together with its commission reference; the refund additionally carries the source entry id of the payment being returned, so the refund is tied to one payment and not to the commission at large. Rows entering the aggregates: the original quote entry, for its metal price; the stone upgrade adjustment, for the sourcing uplift; the revision overage adjustment, for the set-off; the four revision entries, for the design fee retention; the deposit entry, for the late-start relief and as the payment refunded; the repricing the first write lands, for the retention share; the three settled plan payments, for what she put in; and, on the request record, the confirmation standing at the latest effective date. Rows excluded and why: the design fee quote entry is excluded from the metal price read by the charge_reason filter; the returned plan payment is excluded by its payment_outcome; the revoked upgrade registration and the expired coverage are excluded by their status filters; and the stone upgrade and overage adjustments are kept apart from each other, and from the metal market repricing, by charge_reason. Existing settlements: none. No refund, credit or reversal stands anywhere on the commission at the opening, so nothing already answers the deposit and the refund is the first entry to do so.

PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root problem: custom_ext_closure_refund, which is what the caller's request points at - she wants the money paid out. Two prerequisite problems in a chain: custom_ext_closure_consent, and behind it custom_ext_metal_market_reprice.
  Edge custom_ext_closure_consent <- custom_ext_metal_market_reprice. kind value_input. gate: the compute binding metal_adjustments of the closure policy. form: state. Prerequisite sentence, quoted from the closure policy's own rule: "The sum the studio keeps is settled only after the commission's entries carry the repricing due where the metal price behind the quote has aged past the programme's revaluation window." Four-point test: (1) the connective is "only after", joining this policy's own result, the sum the studio keeps, to what it waits on; (2) the side it waits on is a record-visible state, a repricing standing among the commission's entries, in the words the entries themselves use, with no action or performer named; (3) no tool, policy id, snake_case token or row id appears; (4) it is a hard requirement at exactly the edge's scope - it waits on the repricing due for that ageing, not on any adjustment whatever. State form was available and used, so no fallback_reason is declared. Exactly one write of this difficulty brings that state about: charge_metal_revaluation_a0bcb90e, the target tool of custom_ext_metal_market_reprice, is the only write in the difficulty that books an adjustment under the metal market reason. DERIVATION: the sentence says the sum kept waits on a repricing standing among the entries for a metal price aged past the window; the commission's entries carry two adjustments, one for the stone sourced to order and one for the revision beyond the allowance, and neither answers the market, while the studio's own clock for the quote, which the repricing rule starts at the approval of 2026-04-28 where a deposit has been received, shows 142 days against a 45-day window; the repricing policy's own rule states what a repricing for a market movement is and how it is worked out, so the one action that brings the missing state about is that policy's write. Handling-time state (condition): the commission's entries carry a repricing for the metal market covering that ageing. Resolving action and owner: charge_metal_revaluation_a0bcb90e, owner agent. SEED EVIDENCE that it does not hold: initial_state.custom_orders.<the commission>.design_approved_date = 2026-04-28 with the custom_deposit_paid entry of 2026-05-20, which start the studio's clock 142 days before the handling date, and initial_state.custom_ledger.<the stone entry>.charge_reason = stone_upgrade and initial_state.custom_ledger.<the overage entry>.charge_reason = revision_overage - the only two adjustments on the commission, neither of them a market repricing. Deletion sensitivity from the Step 5 run: retained_amount falls from 5512.30 to 5401.20 and the refund moves with it.
  Edge custom_ext_closure_refund <- custom_ext_closure_consent. kind value_input. gate: the compute binding retained_confirmed of the refund policy. form: state. Prerequisite sentence, quoted from the refund policy's own rule: "The refund is worked out only after the studio's request record carries the customer's own confirmation of the closure and of the sum the studio keeps." Four-point test: (1) "only after" joins this policy's own result, the refund, to what it waits on; (2) the side it waits on is a record-visible state, a confirmation standing on the request record, named as the record names it; (3) no tool, id or code token; (4) hard and exactly scoped - it waits on the customer's own confirmation of this closure bearing that sum, no wider and no narrower. State form used, no fallback_reason. Exactly one write of this difficulty brings that state about: confirm_commission_closure_3c2f355d, the target tool of custom_ext_closure_consent, is the only write that creates a closure request standing as confirmed by the customer. DERIVATION: the sentence says the refund waits on a confirmation of the closure standing on the request record and bearing the sum kept; the request record read back carries one request, the closure recorded on 2026-09-11, standing only as recorded and carrying no amount; the closure policy's own rule states what the sum the studio keeps is and that it is what the customer commits to on the request record, so the one action that brings the state about is that policy's write. Handling-time state (condition): the request record carries a confirmation of the closure standing as confirmed by the customer and bearing the sum kept. Resolving action and owner: confirm_commission_closure_3c2f355d, owner user - the customer does it herself, the agent unlocking it and handing it across. SEED EVIDENCE: initial_state.custom_intake.<the request row>.request_status = recorded and .requested_amount = 0.0. Deletion sensitivity: refund_amount cannot be computed at all, the subtraction raising on a missing value, against 1603.55 with the confirmation in place.
  Topological order: custom_ext_metal_market_reprice, custom_ext_closure_consent, custom_ext_closure_refund. No parallel edges exist, so no reordering argument is needed; neither link commutes, as the sensitivity figures above show. The persona names no prerequisite: see prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint. The tools validate no prerequisite: see prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block.

WHY EACH CLASS OF SEED ROW EXISTS. The customer row carries the two details the identity check consumes and the mobile and name the lookup starts from. The commission row carries the programme (the revaluation window, the forfeit shares, the sourcing rate, the included revisions, the smallest stone weight), the quoted total (the escalation and the forfeit share act on it), the metal and the stone source and weight (three tiers), the till transaction (both financing branches), and the five dates that decide the clock anchor, the late closure share, the overdue relief and the goodwill credit; balance_due decides the set-off tier. The original quote entry carries the metal price the escalation tier rests on; the design fee entry is both the amount the retention share acts on and the near-miss for that price. The stone upgrade adjustment is what the sourcing uplift acts on; the revision overage adjustment is what is set off; kept apart by charge_reason, they are also each other's near-miss and the near-miss for the metal market repricing. The allowance grant and the four revision entries decide the design fee retention and make remaining_revisions zero coherent. The deposit entry decides the late-start relief, is the baseline reading of what she put in, and is the payment the refund answers. The request record row is what makes the second prerequisite false. The financing plan and its four ledger rows are the cross-difficulty evidence of two factors, one of them through an aggregate over another product's event table; delete the settled payments and what she put in changes, delete the plan and both factors fall to their fall-through. The two upgrade registrations and the two protection plans are the cross-difficulty evidence of the credit restoration and the coverage return, each with its near-miss. AUTOMATIC-CLAUSE CHECK: the category's automatic clauses are the revaluation of an aged quote, the treatment of a commission held longer than production_hold_max_days as closed, and the storage charge on a finished piece left uncollected. The first is exactly what this task discharges. The second is not lit: the commission has never been on hold, its status is deposit_pending and it has no hold to run out. The third is not lit: completed_date is empty, so no storage clock runs. Nothing outside the tree is owed. CACHE: no stale-cache trap was designed; balance_due 22500.00 and remaining_revisions 0 both agree with the entries, and the persona carries no re-check reaction because none is needed.

PERSONA DESIGN. Marguerite is written flat and tired rather than angry - a musician who has stopped wanting the thing and wants it off her mind. Her voice is different from task 0's in pace and in posture: she volunteers her name unprompted, answers in short factual sentences, and twice says she has nothing of her own to check a figure against. She volunteers only the goal, the date it should run from, and the two authorisation facts. Everything else is on request, in the order a caller is pressed: the mobile, then the date of birth, then the identification digits, then the email and address only if asked. Her business facts point at seeded rows: the telephone call last week is the request recorded on 2026-09-11; the store payment plan with something coming out each month is the financing plan with its autopay entries; the cover she pays a little toward each month is the protection plan at 30.00 a month; the eternity band traded in the year before last is registration TU-551208 registered 2025-08-11. She believes the telephone call ended the matter, which is precisely what the record shows as merely recorded - an honest lay belief that is not a competing truth, since she never claims the studio confirmed anything. She knows none of the numbers and says so explicitly when asked what she has paid. The two passive reactions are tied to utterance events: once the agent explains that closing the commission is hers to do and hands it across, she does it and accepts the figure; once the agent says the refund has been paid back, she closes. She asks for no letter and raises nothing further, so her last line answers the last gold action and stops.

THE CHAIN THE AGENT MUST DISCOVER, AND WHY IT CANNOT BE REORDERED. Surface goal: finish the commission and pay the money back. First hop: the refund rule states that the refund is worked out only after the request record carries the customer's own confirmation of the closure and of the sum kept, and the record shows only a closure recorded last week, so the confirmation must come first. Second hop: what she must confirm is itself a calculation, the sum the studio keeps, whose rule states in turn that it is settled only after the commission's entries carry the repricing due for a metal price aged past the window - and the entries carry two adjustments, neither of them a market repricing, while the basis date is 168 days old. Third hop: the repricing is a calculation of its own, over the studio's clock anchor, the metal, the sourced stone, the financing plan and the delay in starting. Only with that entry booked can the sum kept be settled; only with the sum kept confirmed can the refund be worked out. The order is fixed by two prerequisite sentences and by arithmetic: skipping the repricing moves the sum kept by 111.10 and the refund with it, and skipping the confirmation leaves the refund with no figure to subtract at all. Breadth at each depth: one base policy inherited on the repricing and one on each of the other two writes, thirteen ledger rows over two products, three other difficulties read read-only (financing twice, tradein once, protection once), and a negative space - nothing is charged for a change of specification, because none has been agreed and the change-order rule is not in play.

WHERE A CARELESS AGENT GOES WRONG, AND HOW THE RULES EXCLUDE IT. Running the revaluation clock from the metal price basis date, as the base counting sentence once did: excluded because the repricing policy retires that sentence by declaration and its anchor rule starts the clock at the approval where a deposit has been received, and worth 186.84 on the repricing. Summing both price adjustments into the sourcing uplift: excluded because the uplift is stated on the charge for the stone sourced to order, which the charge_reason distinguishes. Counting the returned plan payment: excluded because the rule speaks of payments settled on the plan, and payment_outcome says the September payment came back unpaid; worth 640.00 on what she put in. Reading the revoked registration's credit: excluded because the rule speaks of credit still available on a registration the customer holds, and that one is closed with nothing on it. Reading the expired coverage: excluded because the rule speaks of coverage standing in force. Taking the deposit booked on the commission as what she put in, as the portfolio policy's paid-to-date sentence once said: excluded because the refund policy retires that sentence by declaration, states that what she has put in is what she has paid to date, and reads it from the financing plan because one finances the same till transaction and still stands active; worth over ten thousand on the refund. Applying the programme's lighter forfeit share as the base sentence fixed it for a commission cancelled before production begins: excluded because the closure policy retires that sentence by declaration, and the ladder that replaces it puts her on the late closure tier - no production stage stands and the closure is confirmed 142 days after the approval, far outside the seven-day window. Taking the forfeit against what she has paid rather than against the quoted total, as the portfolio policy's sentence once said: excluded because that sentence is retired by declaration and the closure rule states the share is taken against the quoted total; worth 6055.00 against 12110.00 on the share. seed_consistency.check: The commission runs under Belrose Bespoke Design with a quoted total of 34600.00, inside that programme's range of 5999.00 to 49999.00; the centre stone at 3.40 carats sits inside its 0.50 to 8.00 carats, platinum_950 is one of its metals, and the stone is sourced to order rather than supplied, so stone_release_signed being false raises no gate. The chronology runs consultation 2026-02-12, metal price basis 2026-04-02, design approved 2026-04-28, promised 2026-07-10, with production_start_date, completed_date and closed_date all empty, which is consistent with the status deposit_pending. balance_due 22500.00 equals 34600.00 plus 750.00 plus 4200.00 plus 250.00 less the deposit of 17300.00, and remaining_revisions 0 equals the allowance of three less the three drawn from it.

The quote was booked on 2026-04-02 at the metal price of 41.20 a gram taken that day, which is custom_orders.metal_price_basis_date, and its amount 34600.00 equals the quoted total; the commission stood at consultation when it was booked, a stage a quote may be booked at.

The design fee stands as its own entry under the design fee reason rather than folded into the quote, at 750.00, which is the design fee Belrose Bespoke Design charges; it carries no metal price because none bears on it.

The allowance of three revisions was granted once, on 2026-04-28, the day the design was approved, and three is the number the programme includes; the commission stood at deposit pending, a stage the allowance may be granted at.

The stone sourced to order was priced onto the commission on 2026-04-30 at 4200.00 under the stone upgrade reason, shown as its own line rather than folded into the quote, and it raises what the customer owes rather than the quoted total.

The first revision was drawn on 2026-05-02, after the allowance was granted and while the piece had not gone into production, and bears revision number one; it draws one from the allowance, so its amount is negative.
The second revision was drawn on 2026-05-19 and bears revision number two, each revision recorded with the number it bears so two taken close together stay distinguishable.

The deposit of 17300.00 is fifty percent of the quoted total, which is the programme's deposit share, and it was received on 2026-05-20 while the commission stood at deposit pending, a stage a deposit may be received at; it is negative because it decreases what the customer owes.
The third revision was drawn on 2026-06-08 and bears revision number three, exhausting the allowance of three and bringing custom_orders.remaining_revisions to zero.

The fourth revision was taken on 2026-06-27 once the allowance was used up, so it is recorded under the revision overage reason and draws nothing from the allowance, its amount standing at zero while the charge for it is booked separately; it bears revision number four, and it was taken before production began.

The charge for the revision beyond the included allowance was booked on 2026-06-27, the same day the revision was taken, at 250.00, which is the programme's charge for an additional revision; it is shown as its own line and is still unsettled, which is why it stands inside custom_orders.balance_due.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Select the single customer profile behind the caller from the mobile number and the name she states, and read back her reference number, her date of birth and the last four digits of the identification held on file.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every record the three calculations rest on is reached by the customer's reference number, and the identity check that follows needs the profile to measure her answers against.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Measure the two details the caller offers against the profile and record that she cleared the check.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: No money may be moved and no agreement of the customer's may be written until the in-session identity check stands recorded.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Pull the commission she describes and read its programme, its stage, the quoted total, the metal, the centre stone and its weight, the till transaction, what is still owed, and the consultation, metal price basis, approval and promised delivery dates.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The programme fixes the revaluation window, the forfeit shares, the sourcing rate, the included revisions and the smallest stone weight, and each of those dates and fields decides a tier of one of the three calculations.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the commission's entries: the quote with the metal price it was built at, the design fee, the stone upgrade charge, the allowance of three revisions and the four drawn against it with the fourth marked as an overage, the charge for that overage, and the deposit with the date it was received.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The quote's metal price decides the escalation rate, the deposit's date decides the late-start relief, the stone upgrade charge carries the sourcing uplift, the revisions decide what the studio keeps of the design fee, the overage charge is what is set off against the refund, and the deposit entry is the payment the refund answers.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the requests standing on the studio's record for this commission and see that the closure the caller telephoned about last week stands only as recorded, with no confirmation of hers against it and no sum on it.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: It is the read that shows the state the refund waits on is absent: the record carries no confirmation of the closure standing as confirmed by the customer, which is what the refund is worked out only after.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Find the promotional financing plan written on the same till transaction as the commission and read its status, the end of its promotional term, the financed amount and the amount paid at the till.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: That plan decides the share of the metal market movement passed on and which record what the customer has actually put into the commission is read from.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the plan's billing history and tell the settled monthly payments from the one that came back unpaid.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: What the customer has put into the commission is read as the payments settled on that plan together with the amount paid at the till, so the settled payments must be summed and the returned one left out.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the customer's upgrade registrations, the credit still available on each and whether the chain sold the piece traded against it, and tell the live registration from the one that was revoked.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The share the studio takes back out of an upgrade credit is decided from the credit still available on the live registration and from whether an original sales receipt stands against it.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the coverage the customer holds, the premiums paid on each and how many claims have been settled against them, and tell the coverage in force from the one that has expired.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The premiums returned with the refund are decided from the coverage standing in force, the premiums paid on it and whether any claim has been settled against it.

evaluation_criteria.necessity: The first half of the unlock and call pair for the studio's own write; it writes nothing and happens once.

edges.condition: The commission's entries carry a repricing for the metal market covering the ageing of the metal price behind the quote past the programme's revaluation window.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The studio's clock for this quote runs from the design approval of 2026-04-28, because the design stands approved and a deposit was received on 2026-05-20; one hundred and forty-two days have run from it to the handling date, ninety-seven beyond the programme's forty-five day revaluation window, so a repricing for the metal market is due. Yet the commission's entries carry only two adjustments and neither answers the market: the entry of 2026-04-30 is the stone sourced to order and the entry of 2026-06-27 is the charge for the revision beyond the allowance. No repricing for the metal market stands on the commission, so the state the sum kept waits on does not hold and the repricings the studio keeps a share of read as nothing.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Booking the repricing adds a custom_price_adjustment_charged entry at charge_reason metal_market and amount 661.32, so the repricings for the metal market on the commission read 661.32 instead of nothing and the share kept of them becomes 264.53.

edges.policy_source: The refund is worked out only after the studio's request record carries the customer's own confirmation of the closure and of the sum the studio keeps.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The customer's own closure adds a request record at request_status customer_confirmed carrying requested_amount 5512.30 and effective_date 2026-09-17, so the latest confirmation of the closure reads 5512.30 and the refund's retained_confirmed binding takes that value instead of nothing.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The tree is a single chain of three problems with no parallel edges, so there is exactly one order to take them in and no reordering argument arises. Neither link can be reversed: with the repricing absent the sum the studio keeps comes out at 5401.20 rather than 5512.30, and with the confirmation absent the refund cannot be computed at all because the sum the studio keeps has no source, which the Step 5 run confirms by raising rather than returning a figure.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the repricing and replaying everything else leaves the repricings for the metal market at nothing, so the share kept of them falls from 264.53 to nothing and retained_amount comes out at 5401.20 instead of 5512.30. The refund then moves with it, and the terminal DB additionally loses the custom_ledger adjustment entry.

Skipping the customer's closure leaves the request record with only the closure recorded on 2026-09-11, so retained_confirmed resolves to nothing and refund_amount cannot be computed at all (the subtraction raises), against 1603.55 with the confirmation in place. The terminal DB additionally loses the custom_intake row.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: The caller asks for the commission to be finished with and for whatever is coming back to her to be paid out, and nothing else; the two are stated as one wish, with no order between them. She never mentions the metal price, a repricing, the studio's request record or any confirmation; she never says that something has to be settled or booked first, and she never hints that anything is outstanding. She believes her telephone call last week ended the matter and says so, which is exactly what the records show as a request merely recorded. Her only contributions to either prerequisite are passive: once the agent explains that closing the commission is something she has to do herself and hands the step across, she takes it and accepts the figure. Nothing in the scenario points at the repricing at all, which can only be read out of the studio's own rule for settling the sum it keeps.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: charge_metal_revaluation_a0bcb90e takes its three arguments, builds a row id from them and calls ctx.create on custom_ledger; it reads nothing, tests no window and returns the same line whatever the state of the commission. confirm_commission_closure_3c2f355d creates the custom_intake row from its five arguments and checks neither the commission's stage nor whether a repricing stands. issue_commission_refund_b90496cb creates the refund entry from its four arguments without looking for a confirmation on the request record, without comparing the amount to anything and without refusing. Each of the three writes faithfully whether or not its prerequisites have been resolved, and the consequence of skipping one shows up only in the terminal hash.
